findings.finding: The committed source-identity determination says no uniform FDLE administrative-expunction form exists.
findings.consequence: The build composes a written application and endorsement section from committed authority and labels it non-official.

findings.finding: An applicant-submitted written request requires a separate written endorsement.
findings.consequence: Every endorsement field is protected for the arresting-agency head/designee or State Attorney/designee.

findings.finding: The current submission mechanics and any fee are not established by the committed records.
findings.consequence: They are disclosed as required-before-submission facts to confirm with FDLE, not guessed.
